remarks: **Charming North Wilton Opportunity - Perfect for Builders or Ambitious Renovators!**  Located on a highly desirable lot on a picturesque street in North Wilton, this property offers endless potential. Builders and investors, here's your chance to create a dream home where the current house stands. With ample space to design something truly special, this is an ideal setting for a custom masterpiece.  For those who prefer to renovate, the house presents an opportunity for a major transformation. Though it requires significant work, the payoff could be stunning in this sought-after location. Whether you build new or breathe new life into this classic home, the setting, location, and potential are unmatched. Don't miss out on this rare offering in one of North Wilton's most coveted neighborhoods!  **Key Features:** - Spacious lot in a prime location - Pool and expansive outdoor space - Potential for new construction or extensive renovation - Convenient access to Wilton's top schools, shopping, and amenities
